pages.text: Frieren's unravelling of Serie's barrier (ep. 21). In her cupped hands a green and black non-Euclidean shape turns through itself and compresses, then a single cone of light rises straight up into the dome; the barrier bands, cracks and shatters into falling shards.
Examination barriers only; you must stand inside or beneath one. Needs full mana. K or Escape skips the camera.
